:::{#def-efficient}
#### Efficient estimator

An [unbiased](estimation.qmd#def-unbiased) estimator $\hparam$ of $\param$ is **efficient**
if its variance equals the [Cramér--Rao lower bound](#thm-cramer-rao):

$$
\Var{\hparam} = \frac{1}{\einf(\param)}
$$

Source: @CaseBerg01 [sec.\ 7.3.2];
@wikipedia_efficiency_statistics.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#rem-efficient-minimum-variance}
#### An efficient estimator has the smallest variance

By the Cramér--Rao lower bound, no unbiased estimator that satisfies its assumptions
has a smaller variance than an efficient one.
Among such estimators, an efficient estimator therefore also has the smallest pMSE
([pMSE equals bias squared plus variance](estimation.qmd#thm-mse-bias-variance), with zero bias).
:::
